name: tanabata-star-well
reviewNotes: All 23 source records reviewed. Preserve the shared origins of Tanabata/moon/dragon-palace peoples, Kaguya's world-support role and the distinct parentage of Vajra's three children.
The Star Well grants one wish per Four Gods sword, not one wish for the whole set. Keep cancel/reselect, impossible maximum-MP wish and already-capped stat branches separate.

Record 11 contains a character name followed by two weapon names; record 22 contains a character name, stat label and numeric gain. Test character/stat fields with five cells, weapons with eight and numbers with five digits.
